page.overview:
What is Walls of Night?

The Walls of the Night, also known as the Walls of the World, were the extraordinary walls that surrounded Arda in ancient times, beyond Ekkaia, the Encircling Sea.

In the west and east of the World, Ekkaia was wide, and the Walls were a great distance from land. In the north and south, however, the Encircling Sea was much narrower. This was how Melkor returned into the World towards the end of the Days before days, coming secretly over the Walls of the Night into the north of Arda, and building there his fortress of Utumno beyond the knowledge of the Valar.

In older versions, the Wall of Things is located on the outer edge of Vai, which is coloured deep blue.

In the Wall of Things, the Valar made two doors; the Door of Night in the West, and the Gates of Morn in the East. Beyond the doors is the 'outer dark', or Vaitya. In the East, the Wall of Things is lower, so that when the Sun returns from the Outer Dark, it rather flies above the Wall than goes through the Doors.
